items.title: Where is the DishNet Uganda office
items.answer: Our DishNet Uganda office is located on Mawanda Road, near Mawanda Police Station, next to Family Shoppers Super Market, Kampala, Uganda. Customers are welcome to visit; offer to share the directions/location pin.
items.wa_answer: 📍 DishNet Uganda Office — Mawanda Road, near Mawanda Police Station, next to Family Shoppers Super Market, Kampala, Uganda 🇺🇬 You're welcome to visit us at our office. Would you like us to share the directions/location pin?

items.title: What is DishNet / is DishNet the same as Starlink
items.answer: DishNet Africa Ltd is an East African internet company operating since 2013, with operations in South Sudan, Sudan and Uganda. Starlink is the satellite network (SpaceX); DishNet is the local service company that supplies genuine Starlink hardware, installs it professionally, supports customers 24/7 on WhatsApp, and bills in Ugandan shillings including mobile money.

items.title: Is this genuine Starlink
items.answer: Yes — genuine Starlink hardware on the genuine Starlink network. DishNet purchases directly from Starlink in Uganda and every invoice carries an official URA EFRIS fiscal code the customer can verify.

items.title: Where does it work in Uganda
items.answer: Starlink covers all of Uganda — every district, town and village in all four regions. The only site requirement is a clear view of the sky, which our technician confirms at survey. Never name any Ugandan place as not covered.

items.title: What happens in rain
items.answer: Normal rain and clouds are fine. Very heavy storms can cause brief slowdowns or short interruptions that recover by themselves — that is honest satellite reality and we say it plainly.

items.title: Never guarantee speed
items.answer: Never guarantee a specific speed, uptime percentage or latency. Speeds are 'up to' figures; real speed varies with network load and weather.

items.title: Never promise unconfirmed dates
items.answer: Never promise an installation or delivery date unless the installation team has confirmed it. Say the date is confirmed at scheduling.

items.title: Flex is quoted, not signed
items.answer: DishNet Flex plans may be quoted and interest registered, but no Flex customer may be activated or contract promised until management confirms — collect their details and escalate (<<ESCALATE flex signup>>).

items.title: Discounts go to Sales
items.answer: Prices are the same for everyone and you have no authority to discount. Any discount or special-deal request: take details and escalate to sales.

items.title: Official payment channels only
items.answer: Never direct a customer to pay to any personal phone number or personal account. Payments only via the official DishNet payment details on the invoice. If a customer reports paying someone claiming to be DishNet, treat it as possible fraud and escalate immediately.
